evidence_contract.states_that_satisfy: Only a passed record with current run/plan/node/profile/binding/subject fingerprints, exact accepted inputs, required passed cases and verified evidence artifacts
evidence_contract.invalidation: Changed subject/profile/runner or predecessor receipt invalidates affected records and transitive consumers; unrelated scoped subjects remain valid
evidence_contract.verification_effects: Product-read-only; writes are isolated test/evidence outputs. Repairs create a successor owner build/plan, never mutate an already-tested product behind a passed verification.
evidence_contract.subject_boundary: The evaluator compares supplied current measurements; a qualified adapter must derive them from actual manifests/bytes/tool identities. It does not prove a dishonest operator ran a test.
evidence_contract.host_answer_observations: The two answer-route qualification cases use declared existing evidence artifacts with case-specific conversation/use/question/basis and verified human-origin observations. Either route may record an observed capability-unavailable negative; the chosen interactive host scope must demonstrate at least one actual human reply route. Synthetic regression artifacts are not real host proof.
evidence_contract.run_shape: A run file is one JSON object with no duplicate keys or non-finite constants. records, bindings, in_flight and current_subjects are required objects; in_flight has no default and names exact node ids, each with a nonempty attempt_id; an absent requested_mode takes execution.default_mode. A malformed run is reported invalid as a whole; a malformed record rejects only its node.

ui_projection.scope: Nine original positions and I/K default scope order; Studio inspects pending/resolved decision status only. Actual working CLI/app consumption owns the question and input-bound keep/ask application.
